correctness.rationale: F4 field represented explicitly by F2[w]/(w²+w+1). Independent enumeration of all 85 projective P3(F4) points gives 45 cubic points and all 27 contained lines; S5 orbit sizes are exactly (5,10,30) and (15,12). Every L15 line contains (1,2,2), each L12 contains (0,0,5), and the 12-line intersection graph is the 6+6 crown. Hermitian smoothness follows A=J4+I4, A²=I4, so classical 27-line theorem ensures geometric exhaustiveness; point tritangent bound gives at most 45 Eckardt points. W(3,2) rational line condition is B(u,v)=0, verifying ovoid attachment. Domain is reduced points/lines of marked smooth special fiber over algebraic closure F2, not relative schemes.
residual_risks: Geometric exhaustiveness rests on classical smooth-cubic line and tritangent theorems, separately identified, not purely an F4 point scan.

evidence: Dolgachev–Duncan, §§5, 12, 13; 45 Eckardt/27 line classification and double-six.
